Ben (Support): Escalating to CS — BrightLane trial is blocked on SSO provisioning. Ticket #12345 shows repeated 403s during `/v1/provision`. Customer is mid-trial, renewal in ~28 days. Needs priority touch; support gave a temporary note but they’re still blocked.
Aisha (CS): On it, thanks Ben. Quick q: customer tier and any committed ARR?
Ben (Support): Starter trial, no ARR yet. Usage spiked after they ran large ingest test, likely hit quota. Error body excerpt: `{"error":"quota_exceeded", "code":403}`. Logs attached in ticket (link).
Carlos (SE): FYI I've seen this pattern — bursty embed jobs trigger quota enforcement and SSO flow can fail if keys rotate during provisioning. We can do a 48-hr emergency quota bump and enable a fallback to smaller batch sizes while we troubleshoot.
Aisha (CS): Proposal for comms & next steps: 1) Immediate outreach + admit impact, 2) Offer 48-hr quota bump while we investigate, 3) Schedule 30-min troubleshooting with SE + engineering, 4) Capture feedback on onboarding docs. Assigning owner: Jordan (CS Manager) to lead outreach and follow-up.
Jordan (CS Manager): I’ll take ownership and lead the outreach. @Vivian (AE) please loop in account context/rev implications. I’ll draft an email to the customer and propose a remediation timeline.
Vivian (AE): Thanks — pls include a brief renewal-friendly line: we’re prioritizing pilot completion and will share timeline. Keep tone proactive.
Ben (Support): Updated ticket: "Escalated to CS. Temporary quota bump +1000 units applied for 48h. Point of contact: Jordan." Also adding curl example used by customer: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxx' -d '{"tenant":"brightlane"}'`
Aisha (CS): Draft email I'll post in 10m. Subject suggestion: "Redwood — immediate SSO support & trial access update".
Jordan (CS Manager): Scheduling a call: 2024-03-05 16:00 PST (30m). Invites sent to BrightLane, SE, and Ben. Action items tracked: (A) Jordan: send email + own outreach, (B) Carlos/SE: confirm quota bump and triage logs, (C) Docs: add short SSO runbook step, (D) CS: capture feedback and flag renewal risk in CRM.
Maya (Docs): Noted — will prioritize a concise SSO runbook patch and an onboarding bullets update by EOB tomorrow.
Aisha (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup: After call we’ll capture a short playbook entry so this doesn’t recur. I’ll also create a 48h follow-up note and assign retention flag in CRM — leaning to proactive enablement to protect renewal.
Ben (Support): Leaving a final note in ticket: "Customer unblocked? pending call. If still blocked after quota bump, escalate to eng oncall."
Jordan (CS Manager): Great — I’ll post the customer-facing email and share copy here for review. Expect follow-up and a brief postmortem in 48h with root cause and remediation steps.
